body.name: \Omega_{G,\mathcal J}
body.construction: \(\Omega_{G,\mathcal J}=\bigsqcup_{r\in\mathcal R_G}\{r\}\times\prod_a\mathcal K_{G,r,a}\). For \(\omega=(r,\kappa)\), deterministic observational and interventional recursion defines \(T_{G,\mathcal J}(\omega)=((e_w(\omega))_{w\in\{0,1\}^{\mathcal W_H}},(d_j(\omega))_{j\in\mathcal J})\).
